title: The Obsidian Chain-Bridge
summary: Suspended over boiling ley-magma, Ashenspire Forge roars with overdriven bellows.

art.caption: Colossal iron chains suspend a glowing basalt foundry above veins of liquid gold magma.

relicCard.caption: Dwarven Quench Locker — click to flip & decipher

text: Heat ripples upward from the caldera floor as you cross the riveted chain-bridge into Ashenspire Forge. Pillars of gilded steam shriek from pressure stacks that should have lain silent for a hundred winters.

Master-Smith Brannor kneels beside a shattered anvil near the gatehouse, soot streaking his braided beard. "The Ashen Covenant seized the Heart-Crucible," he rasps. "They're pouring raw ley-fire onto Ignaroth's bindings—the elder cinder-drake who guarded the first smiths!"
Two paths descend into the foundry: the high Gantry Catwalk overlooking the zealots, or the Quench Tunnels running straight beneath the crucible.

choices.label: Trace the pressure pipes in the Quench Tunnels to bleed off the zealots' ley-siphon.

relicBypass.bonusText: Frost-Quench Brand cools the manifold cleanly (+100 Mastery)

choices.label: Vault across the swaying iron gantries above the pyromancers' watch.
"A chained dragon in a volcanic basement? Honestly, I've seen worse guild meetings." Trade plans with Brannor.

title: The Hall of True Smiths
summary: Behind molten curtains sits the original Dwarven-Elven anvil where the drake's pact was sealed.

art.caption: Runed pillars encircle a black star-iron anvil untouched by the encroaching slag.

relicCard.caption: Anvil of the True Smiths — click to flip & unlock the Charter

text: Brannor's secret passage opens into the Hall of True Smiths. Carved across the basalt ceiling is the forgotten truth: Ignaroth was never enslaved—the cinder-drake swore a voluntary oath to temper the Star-Spire anchors, until Hollow Crown zealots drove agonizing Veil-chains through its wings.
Footsteps ring on iron grates as an Ashen Covenant Pyromancer strides into the hall, brandishing a smoking siphon-rod!

choices.label: Strike down the Ashen Covenant Pyromancer before they sound the horn!
Show the True Smiths' Charter to the wavering forge-guards flanking the pyromancer!

relicBypass.bonusText: True Smiths' Charter turns the forge-guards against the zealot (+100 Mastery)!

title: The Crucible Catwalk
summary: From the iron rafters, you spot the zealots' tithe chest and a pyromancer priming the final chain.

art.caption: Chains thick as oak trunks glow white-hot over a churning basin of ley-fire.

relicCard.caption: Master Foreman's Strongbox — click to flip & claim the Charter

text: Sparks drift like fireflies across the catwalk. Below, an Ashen Covenant Pyromancer chants over the primary siphon-lever, channeling dark Veil energy straight into Ignaroth's collar.
An open iron coffer beside them holds stolen gold—and the final sigil needed to ascend to the Crown of Glass.

choices.label: Drop from the catwalk and engage the Pyromancer in steel and flame!
Sever the counterweight cable to jam the Veil siphon cleanly.

title: The Slag Spillway
summary: Molten ley-fire breaches the lower floor as the caldera trembles.

art.caption: Rivers of liquid gold surge around basalt stepping-stones toward the Crucible.

text: The foundry shudders as a massive wing-beat blows ember-storms through the archway. Molten slag spills across the stone causeway, leaving only narrow runed pillars above the blaze.
Reach the Heart-Crucible before Ignaroth breaks free in berserk agony!

choices.label: Sprint across the basalt pillars through the rising ember-gale.
Drive straight through the heat behind raised steel and iron resolve.

title: The Heart-Crucible
summary: Ignaroth the Cinder-Drake strains against blazing Veil-chains over the molten ley-core.

art.caption: A colossal dragon of obsidian and living gold flares its wings above the caldera.

text: Ignaroth towers over the glowing crucible—scales like hammered obsidian threaded with rivers of gold. Blackened Veil-chains bite deep into the drake's collar, driving it half-mad with pain.
"LITTLE MORTALS!" Ignaroth's roar rattles every rivet in the foundry. "YOU BROKE THE SMITHS' OATH AND CHAINED MY FIRE TO SHADOW!"
You spot the glowing lock-pin binding the Veil-chain—and remember Ignaroth's true Concord name.

choices.label: Press the Frost-Quench Brand onto the Veil-collar and speak Ignaroth's Concord Oath!

relicBypass.bonusText: Frost-Quench Brand shatters the Veil-chains for a Golden Path (+100 Mastery)!

choices.label: Stand before the wyrm and battle Ignaroth to stabilize the Forge by force!
"The Smiths didn't betray you, Ignaroth—the Hollow Crown stole the forge! Look upon the True Charter!"

relicBypass.bonusText: True Smiths' Charter calms Ignaroth's fury (+100 Mastery)!

title: Fury of the Caldera
summary: Ignaroth inhales liquid gold fire—only battle or emergency venting remains!

art.caption: Walls of golden fire roar across the obsidian platform.

text: The Veil-collar pulses violently, blinding Ignaroth in searing pain. The colossal drake rears back, talons splitting the obsidian deck!
Stand your ground in battle, or blow the outer slag-gates to quench the crucible and escape the collapse.

choices.label: Face Ignaroth the Cinder-Drake in mortal combat!
Blow the outer cooling sluice to smother the crucible and retreat.

title: The Covenant Rekindled
summary: Ignaroth casts off the Veil-chains, re-forges Valenmoor's ley-anchor, and bestows a mythic signet.

art.caption: Golden fire climbs smoothly up the spire-channels as the great drake bows its crowned head.

text: The Veil-chains snap with a thunderclap that sends every remaining zealot fleeing for the hills. Ignaroth settles majestically beside the crucible, breathing pure golden flame into the ley-channels.
With one obsidian claw, the drake nudges a glowing Cinder-Lord's Signet across the stone to your feet. "When you ascend the Crown of Glass, Oathkeeper, my fire shall hold the sky beneath you."
High above the caldera, the shimmering sky-bridge to the shattered Crown of Glass flares open.

ending.headline: Oathkeeper of Ashenspire
ending.epilogue: Ignaroth and Master-Smith Brannor rekindle the ancient anvil, sending golden star-fire up toward the drifting Crown of Glass.

title: Master of the Crucible
summary: Ignaroth yields, the Veil-chains are shattered, and the sky-way to the Crown of Glass opens.

art.caption: Cool blue twilight settles over smoking obsidian bridges as the ley-core steadies.

text: Your decisive blow shears straight through the Veil-shackle at Ignaroth's throat. Exhausted, the cinder-drake sinks into the cooling embers with a low rumble of grudging respect before gliding out into the mountain peaks.
Brannor stabilizes the crucible valves and hands you the ascension key—only one reach remains: the Crown of Glass.

ending.headline: Champion of Ashenspire Forge
ending.epilogue: The molten ley-veins steady beneath Ashenspire, illuminating the final sky-road to the Crown of Glass.

title: Cold Iron, Quiet Caldera
summary: The cooling sluice stops the zealots' ritual, though Ashenspire's ancient fires dim to ash.

art.caption: White steam clouds the silent foundry as distant star-spires flicker overhead.

text: Tons of glacial runoff hiss across the crucible, extinguishing the zealots' siphon in towering clouds of steam. Ignaroth tears free into the stormy sky, roaring over the peaks.
Ashenspire's anvil grows cold—but the Hollow Crown's grand design is laid bare, and the final spire awaits above the clouds.

ending.headline: Quencher of the Caldera
ending.epilogue: Ashenspire falls silent beneath a veil of steam, leaving only the fractured Crown of Glass hanging above Valenmoor.
